mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_file_hash (file_hash, object_name, size, mime_type, ref_count) VALUES (#{fileHash}, #{objectName}, #{size}, #{mimeType}, #{refCount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_file_hash WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_hash SET ref_count = ref_count + 1 WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash}
UPDATE t_file_hash SET ref_count = ref_count - 1 WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash} AND ref_count > 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_file_hash WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash} AND ref_count <= 0
